notes.title: New location: the Desert🏜️🐫🌵
notes.content:
[h1]Hi our survivors.[/h1]
In this news we would like to demonstrate to you a new location which is the desert 🏜️.

[b]New animals[/b] 🐫 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1667180/view/3675534386979825138?l=english
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750217/279e854f2a56dd0b1a66055ce91b336dd2116669.png[/img]

[b]New enemies[/b] - which that appears at night ⚔️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750217/1a0a188db56e28085ea649229beb9d9cee0d6b89.png[/img]

[b]Poisonous zones[/b] 🧪
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750217/78f1bfa3a011b3f4aca2595fb0916dec902014f3.png[/img]

[b]Dungeon Desert [/b]  🦂
Underground temperature does not rise very much, you have to face there red fireballs that deal a lot of damage, it is a difficult dungeon. Here you have to get a dragon egg.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750217/8b00d2bfa27fba8220bab2160e7a81c12634a3de.png[/img]


[b]The portal[/b] 🚪
The last portal to leave the island. Here you need to collect the necessary materials to open the portal. But it will not be easy at all to do it by killing all the bosses
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750217/f4c97b1a344726b708e2475bb1d6cb7c57e3e445.png[/img]

[b]Moreover[/b]
- New dungeons: with traps, strong enemies, resources for crafting, 
- Fishing area with new fish
- Chests: you will find in them new recipes for making weapons and armor, cooking

notes.title: STREAM NO MAN'S ISLAND
notes.content:
Welcome to No Man's Island! Today we are launching the demo version 1.06 of our game and we are so excited about it! We listened to your feedback and made a lot of changes. If you have an idea how we could improve the game, please let us know in the feedback section or send us a message. So go ahead, play and enjoy!

Patch notes "Demo 1.06":


[list]
[*] New tool: Sickle, now you need the Sickle to get Fiber and Wheat.

[*] New Level system: In the Crafting window, now you have to level up to unlock more things to craft (test phase)

[*] New Pet: Neutral, it only helps you search for hidden treasures underground. click on the pet and select Tame.

[*] New UI system, now if you don't have the tool, a message will appear on the screen with the image of the tool you need.

[*] You start with a Flag in your inventory. It can be picked up and placed wherever you want to mark a position on the map, for example your house.

[*] More copper mines have been added to the map.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Craft cost has been reduced:[/b]
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Arrows
[*] Foundation
[*] Wall
[*] Wall with window
[*] Stairs
[/olist]

[list]
[*] Some bugs have been fixed.
[/list]


[b]Important :
If you have a Saved Game, delete it and
Start a New Game.[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes No Man's Island Demo
notes.content:
Welcome to [b]No Man's Island[/b]! Today we are launching the demo version 1.04 of our game and we are so excited about it! We listened to your feedback and made a lot of changes. If you have an idea how we could improve the game, please let us know in the feedback section or send us a message. So go ahead, play and enjoy!

[b]Patch notes "Demo":[/b] 

[b]The demo has now no day's limit: you can play as long as you wish. In the demo version you have limited crafting possibilities and you can only move within one biome.[/b]


[list]
[*] Added Map (key: M)
[*] Item icon's background in the crafting menu is now green when the player has all required materials for crafting it
[*] Added 2 Bosses: [b]Ent [/b] and  [b]Cyclops[/b]
[*] Added new Animal: Fox
[*] Added recipe Alchemy Table (The recipe is dropped from the Enemy Chest in the Crypt (Dungeon))
[*] Added Ent Item
[*] Added Cyclope Item
[*] Added Background Music
[*] Added item Saw. Saw is needed in order to Refine Wood
[*] Added message "Inventory is Full"
[*] Added Crafting queue for crafting more than one Item
[*] Added "Water Well" in the starting area
[*] Added "Dragon Egg" Use it on the alchemy table to create your Pet
[*] Added "Cane plant" and "Sugar ingredient" 
[*] Renamed Material "Skin" to "Rabbit Skin"
[/list]


[i][b]Important :[/b][/i]
If you have a Saved Game, delete it and 
Start a New Game.
